candidates.file: Waiheke Island Oneroa Beach from Korora Road.jpg
candidates.reason: Current. 2014 colour photo, Oneroa Bay (Waiheke) category; wide sweep of beach, bay and pohutukawa. Overcast with houses on the ridge, so modest, but a wide island-coast scene; 4:3, 4608px.
Current. 2025 photo, categories Vineyards/Waiheke Island; vine leaves in foreground, blue Hauraki Gulf and islets behind: vineyards with sea views. Fence posts a little dominant, still passes.
Current. Category Onetangi Bay; long white beach receding to a headland. Plain light but clearly a long sandy beach.
Current. 2023 photo under Waiheke Island; sheltered turquoise bay with boats ringed by green hills. Description is generic so place rests on category.
Current. Onetangi Bay category, long beach and The Strand visible; recognisable as the beach.

candidates.file: Waiheke CBV Vineyard Views Pinot Gris Olives (1).jpg
candidates.reason: Current. 2025 photo, 'CBV' vineyard views, categories Wineries/Waiheke Island; hillside vines and olive tree over the gulf. Cable Bay not proven beyond the file name, but acceptable.

Current. Genuine Oneroa Bay photo (2014, category Oneroa Bay) but grey, overcast, low tide, no village or clifftop; weak though acceptable for a spot. A better Oneroa shot would be an upgrade; none supplied.

2010 colour photo, category Stony Batter; clearly a concrete gun emplacement with entrance tunnel on the hills, the named thing. Botanical file name is misleading; the image is the emplacement. 3264px. Visitor stands in it for scale only.
Stony Batter category, but a painted boulder face on a hillside, not the tunnels or gun emplacements.
Painted boulder face again, not the tunnels or gun emplacements.

candidates.file: Stony Batter boulders and young pohutukawa.jpg
candidates.reason: Bouldered paddock landscape; not the defence works.
Pleasant coastal view over Hooks Bay but no tunnel or gun emplacement.
Close-up of engine pistons in the bunker, 2007 phone quality, not recognisable at thumbnail size.
Current. Colour 2005 Kodak shot of a gun emplacement, right subject, but 896px wide (below the 960 minimum) and soft; superseded by the 3264px emplacement photo.
Current. 2024 CC0 photo from a Matiatia track; harakeke, cabbage tree and pohutukawa framing a gulf headland view as the bio says. Dusk light; wharf not shown but the headland view is the point.
